kind: rigid weapon (AGENTS.md: rigid items are placed by anchor with integer offsets)
construction: band: a straight band along the weapon axis from the grip point (the centre of the near fist); every pixel takes its colour from the cross-section pattern (back/spine to front/edge) of the segment it falls in, so the weapon keeps its thickness at any angle; pixels are rasterised from the authored data, never rotated or resampled from an image
outline: every coloured pixel touching empty space gets an outline pixel (#) if it is not already one
units: pixels along the axis from the grip point (u, positive toward the tip) and across it (v)
